grace.title: Too many users for your seats
grace.text: Reduce {{module}} to {{capacity}} users by {{date}}, or add seats.

over.title: Some users are read-only
over.text: {{n}} {{module}} users are read-only because of the seat limit.

me.title: Read-only access
me.text: Your {{module}} access is read-only because the workspace has more users than seats. Ask the workspace owner.

swap.title: Who keeps a seat
swap.moduleHint: Applications over their seat limit or in a grace period.
swap.haveSeatHint: Choose the user who gives up the seat and becomes read-only.
swap.readOnlyHint: Choose the read-only user who gets the seat.
swap.confirm: {{keep}} gets the seat, and {{release}} becomes read-only.
swap.graceDisabled: Available after the grace period. Remove roles or add seats now.
swap.help: During the grace period nobody is read-only yet; choose now who keeps a seat by removing roles, or add seats.
swap.empty: No application is over its seat limit.
